name: Anchor Ingredients - Corporate Office
old_description: At Anchor Ingredients, we are the trusted link from the farm to finished foods, providing ultimate connectivity throughout the entire supply chain. With exceptional products, a relentless attention to detail and proactive customer support, we’re committed to ensuring your brand’s success.
about:
Anchor Ingredients is a privately owned specialty ingredient supplier headquartered in Fargo, North Dakota. Established as a link between agricultural producers and food brands, the company has grown into a coast-to-coast network with offices, manufacturing facilities, and warehouses across the United States.

The company provides a range of soil-to-shelf services including farm-level ingredient sourcing, custom processing, freeze-dry co-manufacturing, blending, logistics, and distribution. Its portfolio spans conventional and organic ingredients for both human and pet food markets, supported by multiple processing facilities nationwide.

Anchor serves brands in the pet food and human food industries, offering supply chain management and co-manufacturing partnerships. Customers include food manufacturers seeking traceable, premium ingredients and integrated logistics solutions.

Founded on a mission to cultivate connectivity and quality across the food supply chain, Anchor emphasizes transparency, traceability, and sustainability. The company highlights its stringent supplier approval program, in-house testing validated by third parties, and a digital portal that provides certificates of analysis and traceability reports for every order.
